Commentary.Commentary: That wraps up the formalities of this game. The two sides will battle it out on Sunday at the Wanderers. It will be a day game and the action starts at 1330 IST. Do join us for that one. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

QUINTON DE KOCK (MAN OF THE MATCH) says that the pitch was really good to bat on especially in the second innings when it skid on nicely. Feels that he and Rossouw didn't have to do anything extravagant to get quick runs. Hopes to get more such pitches in the series.

FAF DU PLESSIS feels that it was a good toss to win. Says that it's been a good chasing ground always although international cricket matches stats say otherwise. Agrees that the roller used in the break helped the track to play better in the second half. Still feels de Kock's knock was just too special. Credits his bowlers for doing well athough he wasn't happy by allowing Australia off the hook after having them 6 down. Hopes his side can work on it. Feels it was a 360 pitch perhaps. Feels that he should have tried to stay till the end. States that he is happy with the win but doesn't want his mates to be complacent in the next game.

STEVEN SMITH feels that it was a 370-380 pitch in hindsight. Opines that his batsmen couldn't convert their starts and lauds de Kock for his superlative knock. Says that they were targeting a mid 300 total but lost wickets in clumps. Praises Bailey and Hastings for their knocks but asserts that the total wasn't enough. Hopes that his bowlers can respond better in the next game.

When a target of 295 is chased inside the 37th over, you really don't have to say much about the bowling. Australia were clueless with the ball particularly in the first 10 overs after which they never really recovered. All the bowlers got stick and nobody really managed to make an impression. Boland got a few wickets towards the end but by then, their fate had already been sealed. Lots to ponder about for the World Champions to think about in the bowling department.

What a run chase by South Africa! It was the Quinton de Kock show as the opener absolutely tore into the inexperienced Australian attack, notching up the second highest individual score in ODIs by a SA batsman. His century stand with fellow opener Rilee Rossouw all but sealed the fate of the Australians. A cluster of wickets towards the end including the one of de Kock delayed the win but David Miller and Farhaan Behardien duly finished things off with 13.4 overs left.
That seals it! Back of a length on leg stump, Miller gets across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a single. A cakewalk for the hosts in the end. SA WIN BY 6 WICKETS.
Good length outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
DANIEL WORRALL comes back on.
Back of a length outside off, Miller pushes at it as the outside edge flies towards third man for a single. Scores are level now.
Short and wide outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
Fuller and outside off, driven firmly off the front foot towards mid off.
Dug in short on off, Behardien works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length on leg stump, tucked to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! SLASHED HARD! Short and wide outside off, Miller flashes at that one and gets a thick slice that just flies over the first slip to the fence. Just a hit away now, South Africa!
Dug in short on leg stump, ducks under that bumper.
Good length on middle and off, worked away towards mid on for a single.
Pitched up outside off, driven firmly towards mid off. Wants a single but won't get it.
Fuller on middle and off, Miller works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Shortish outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Pitched up outside off, Behardien leans forward and caresses it through the covers. Finds the gap although it won't reach the fence. Three more to the total.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
FARHAAN BEHARDIEN is the new man in.

OUT! DE KOCK DEPARTS! Cluster of wickets which isn't going to change the result though! Another short ball succeeds for Australia as Boland's bumper forces a top edge to deep square leg where Head takes another good sliding catch. Suddenly the short balls working for the Aussies which begs the question, why didn't they try more earlier? Take a bow, Quinton! One of the greatest ODI knocks by a South African!
Shortish on off, de Kock goes for the pull but misses.
DAVID MILLER is the new man in.
Drinks break....

OUT! GOES THIS TIME! Boland has another! Dug in short on middle and off, Duminy goes for the pull and gets a top edge to deep mid-wicket where Head takes a good low catch diving forward. SA's victory will have to wait just a while longer due to these late wickets.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Full and outside off, Duminy steps out to that one and carts it over mid off. Clean shot and another boundary for JP.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot to cover.
FOUR! CRASHED! Half volley outside off, screamer of a cover drive from Duminy as the ball rockets across the turf to the fence. Pure timing!
Length ball angled away from outside off, Duminy steps out to play a half-hearted lofted shot but misses.
Back of a length wider outside off, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and wide outside off, de Kock leans into it and creams it through the covers for a brace.
Shortish outside off, Duminy hangs back and defends it well.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
JP DUMINY is the new man in.

OUT! PLAYED ON! Good length outside off, Faf looks to drive away from the body and gets a thick inside edge that cannons on to the stumps. The skipper has to depart but it will only delay in the inevitable as SA are all but home in this game.
Length ball outside off, crunched off the back foot through the covers for a brace.
Back of a length outside off, extra bounce as Faf fends it awkardly towards point.
Fuller on leg stump, de Kock goes across and whips it away through square leg for a single.
SCOTT BOLAND is back on.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Faf drives it through cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
Wide! Full and very wide outside off, no shot offered and wide called.

SIX! SPARE THEM NOW DE KOCK! This is absolute torture for the bowlers! Another length ball outside off, in the slot and Quinton slogs it over deep mid-wicket for another maximum. If this was a boxing bout, K.O would have come multiple times already. What a knock by the young man!
Shortish and outside off, crashed off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
MITCHELL MARSH is back on.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Zampa says 'no please'! Floats it up on middle and off, de Kock's six-hitting spree ends as he mistimes the sweep to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! 3 IN 3! Flighted on middle and off, de Kock goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it with ease over deep mid-wicket for another biggie. Is he looking for the 6 in 6? Your guess is as good as mine.

SIX! AND AGAIN! Floats it up outside off, de Kock leans into it and launches it straight down the ground over long off. Sheer timing there and the bat swing was exemplary. The ball clears the ropes with ease.

SIX! SMASHED! WHAT A SHOT! Floats it up outside off, de Kock goes inside out over the covers. Connects it well and sends it soaring over the ropes for a biggie. Tough shot against a leggie but he makes it look so easy.
ADAM ZAMPA is back on.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a brace as Marsh makes a good stop.
Short and outside off, cut away to the deep for a single.

SIX! ANOTHER SHORT BALL DISAPPEARS! Banged into the surface on middle and leg line, de Kock goes back to that one and clubs the pull over deep square leg for another maximum. I've lost count of the biggies he's hit between mid-wicket and deep backward square leg today, mostly off half-trackers.
Back of a length on middle and leg, pulled away to the leg side.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side for a single.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.

SIX! Oh, ho ho! There he goes again! Another short ball on middle and off, de Kock goes back to that one and pulls it way over deep backward square leg for yet another maximum. Terrific strike as he motors along.

FOUR! SLAMMED! Fullish on middle and off, de Kock goes across to that one and slogs it through wide mid on for another boundary. He wants to finish this at the earliest and probably go for a party after that.

FOUR! ANOTHER HALF-TRACKER DESTROYED! Short on middle and leg, de Kock stays back and mauls it over mid-wicket. Meaty blow and that speeds to the fence in no time. Doesn't he ever get bored of hitting like this? What a player!
Back of a length on off, pulled away to mid-wicket where it is well stopped by Smith.
Short of a length outside off, de Kock steps out to have a go at it but misses.
Back of a length outside off, steered to point for a single.
MITCHELL MARSH is back on.
Back of a length around off, extra bounce takes Faf by surprise as he looks to fend at it. The ball flies off the glove down to third man for a single.
Wide! Short ball and Faf ducks under it. Wide given for height.
Pitched up outside off, driven sweetly through the covers for a single.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Faf gets back and dabs it to the off side.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Back of a length wider outside off, de Kock chases it but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Floats it up on middle and off, de Kock clips it down to long leg for a single.
Speared in on middle and leg, Faf tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Short and down the leg side, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid on.
Flatter outside off, steered towards point for a single.
TRAVIS HEAD is back on.
Shortish outside off, blocked off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
50-run stand between du Plessis and de Kock.
Fuller outside off, driven straight back down the ground to long off for a single.
Good length on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to point for a single.
JOHN HASTINGS is back on.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked to the leg side.

FOUR! HOW DO YOU STOP HIM? Flatter and short outside off, de Kock stays back to that one and cuts it hard through point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. The Australians just have no answers for this man tonight.

FOUR! PUNISHED! Full toss on leg stump, de Kock clears his front leg and slog sweeps it through square leg to find another boundary. As it is, he is smashing even the normal deliveries and then he's given a full toss. Whoa!
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the covers.
Flatter outside off, steered towards point.

FOUR! NAILED IT! He's just making it so easy. Floats it up on middle and off, de Kock goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over square leg. Just goes to the fence on the bounce. He's in that untouchable mode at the moment.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
Pitched up outside off, drilled to mid off for a single.

SIX! DUMPED! How many such shots have we seen today? Full and on leg stump, de Kock goes across to that one and plays a terrific pick up shot over fine leg for a maximum. Clean strike and that was a terrific dropkick.
Wide! Speared well down the leg side, no shot offered and it's a wide.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
11th ODI ton for de Kock.

SIX! WHAT A SHOT TO BRING IT UP! Back of a length around off, de Kock stays back to that one and pulls it away over deep mid-wicket for a big maximum. Clinical strike to reach the three-figure mark. Sensational stuff!
Back of a length outside off, de Kock cuts it hard to backward point where Bailey gets a hand to parry it to the deep. Brace added.
Flatter and short just outside off, slapped away to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter on leg stump, QDK gets across and works it to the leg side.
Flighted outside off, nice drive from de Kock but straight to short cover.
Floats it up on middle and off, de Kock goes for the drive and slices it to cover.
Flighted outside off, Faf leans forward and pushes it down the ground to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Fullish on off, drilled straight back down the track as Worrall makes a fine stop on his followthrough.
Pitched up on off, de Kock gets across and checks his pull to mid on.
Shortish and outside off, steered towards point.
Length ball outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Good length outside off, chopped through point for a single.

FOUR! BLASTED AWAY! Full toss on off, someone in the mood like de Kock won't miss out and launches it over wide mid on as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. Not a day Worrall would want to remember - mistakes with the ball and also poor on the field.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Drifting in a bit outside off, low bounce as Faf is beaten on the drive.
Loopy and around off, Faf leans forward and blocks it well.
Floats it up on off, crunched down the ground to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Good length outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball outside off, steered towards point.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Good length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.

OUCH! THE UMPIRE'S HURT! Full and outside off, de Kock absolutely blasts it back down the track as it rams straight into the umpire who tried to take evasive action. Must have stung him for sure. Saved a boundary for the Australians though as that ball was traveling.
DANIEL WORRALL is back on.
Full and wide outside off, driven through point for a single.

Slider and short on leg stump, de Kock goes back and pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket where Head makes a good sliding stop. The umpires want to check if his foot was touching the ropes but it seems fine. Brace added.
Tossed up fuller outside off, driven nicely to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! POOR FIELDING! Drops it short on middle and leg, Faf goes back and pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket where Worrall makes a mess of the stop to let it through to the fence. That's the last thing a team needs when it's under pressure.
Loopy on a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
FAF DU PLESSIS walks out to bat.

OUT! STRIKES FIRST BALL! Huge sigh of relief for the Australians! Floats up the leg break around off, turns in a bit as Rossouw goes for the reverse sweep. Poor shot first up to a new bowler and he is rapped on the pads. That's about as plumb as it gets and the lbw appeal is given. Ends a powerful knock from Rilee. He's set it up nicely for SA.
ADAM ZAMPA comes on to bowl.
Drinks break....

FOUR! ONE OF THE SHOTS OF THE DAY! Length ball outside off, de Kock leans into it and drills it straight back past the bowler down the ground to the long off fence for a boundary. These two are making a mockery of the chase.
Good length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards mid off.
SIX! SMOKED AWAY! Both batsmen are toying with the bowlers now. Shortish on middle and leg, de Kock swivels across to pull it over deep square leg for the second maximum of the over.
Back of a length outside off, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! SAILED INTO THE STANDS! Banged in short on middle and off, Rossouw pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Didn't try keeping it down but with the form he is in, why should he?
Back of a length on middle and leg, tucked off the back foot down to fine leg for a single.
SCOTT BOLAND is back on.
Dug in short on middle and off, Rossouw mistimes the pull but gets it well over mid-wicket to the deep. Brace taken.

FOUR! CLOBBERED AWAY! Short and wide outside off, Rossouw waits for it and cuts it nicely through backward point as the ball speeds to the fence for a boundary. These two continue to pile on the misery for the visitors.
Shortish and just outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Back of a length outside off, defended well off the back foot towards cover.
Short ball on middle and leg, Rossouw ducks under it.
Shortish on middle and leg, worked off the back foot down to fine leg for a single.
It's Rossouw's turn to change his bat.
Length ball outside off, Rossouw steps out to play the lofted drive but mistimes it a bit. Just short of the fielder at mid off.
Back of a length outside off, glided off the back foot down to third man for a single.
Change of bat for de Kock.

SIX! THAT'S GONE WAYYYYYY INTO THE STANDS! Length ball on off, de Kock stays deep in the crease and swings across the line. Meaty blow and that clears the ropes comfortably to get a biggie. Seems like he has done some damage to his bat in the process too.
Back of a length on off, de Kock goes back to that one and jabs it on to the track.
6th ODI fifty for Rossouw.
Shortish on leg stump, doesn't rise as expected but Rossouw adjusts well to pull it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a brace.
Short ball on middle and leg, pulled towards square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, steered off the back foot to point for a single.
Good length outside off, blocked from the crease to point.

FOUR! DROPPED! Whoa, the rub of the green is definitely with the Men in Green! Short ball again and Rossouw goes for another pull. The top edge goes to fine leg where Marsh does everything right as he times his dive to perfection but spills the chance at the last moment. The ball rolls to the fence. Would have been a blinder had he taken it but he should have snapped it after having done all the hard work.

ANOTHER TOP EDGE FALLS SAFE! Dug in short on middle and off, heavy ball from Hastings and Rossouw top edges a pull towards mid-wicket. Worrall goes backwards and dives but the ball just goes over him. Single taken.
Good length outside off, steps out and blocks it to the leg side.
JOHN HASTINGS is back on.
Length ball around off, de Kock leans forward and blocks it firmly to the ground.
Full and wide outside off, glorious drive through the covers. Head in the deep runs to his left to make the stop. Brace added.
Good length on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven firmly but straight to the covers.
Full and outside off, nicely driven but straight to short cover.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! RUNS KEEP COMING! Dropped short again on leg stump, de Kock goes deep in his crease and pulls it hard to the deep square leg fence for a boundary. No stopping him at the moment. Australia need a wicket badly.
Fuller on off, bunted towards mid on for a single.
Drifting away on a length outside off, chopped towards point for a single.
Slider outside off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the back foot to the covers.
8th ODI fifty for de Kock.
FOUR! SMASHED! Drags it short on middle and leg, half-tracker and de Kock pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
TRAVIS HEAD comes on to bowl.
Back of a length outside off, blocked well off the back foot.

UPPISH BUT SAFE! De Kock gets lucky again! Good length angled away outside off, steps out to play across the line and gets a top edge that goes to third man. Boland comes in a bit but it falls short of him and gets through towards the ropes. He does well to get back and prevent the boundary. A sharper fielder may have taken the catch perhaps. Single taken.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards cover where Smith does well to get a hand on it. Parries it to mid off.
Shortish around off, de Kock looks to flick and gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Length ball outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the covers.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a couple.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the ring.

FOUR! BANG! Shortish on middle and leg, sits up for Rossouw who pulls it away well through square leg. Another boundary and it ends a brilliant powerplay for SA. It's looking all too easy for the hosts at the moment.
Good length outside off, Rossouw leans into it and drives it sweetly to mid off.
Back of a length on off, pulled away to the leg side.

FOUR! Whack! 'Doesn't matter where you bowl, I'm going to smash you' mode activated from the openers! Rossouw was giving the charge and Boland dug it in short. Rilee goes through with the pull and sends it through wide mid on for yet another boundary.

FOUR! BRILLIANT STUFF! Full and outside off, Rossow leans forward and plays a languid drive through cover-point. Stunning timing and it races away to the fence for another boundary. It's all South Africa at the moment folks.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover for a single.
FOUR! MORE RUNS! Fuller outside off, Rossouw leans into it and unleashes a scorching drive straight back past the bowler. Struck well and it races away down the ground to the ropes for a boundary.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Overpitched outside off, Rossouw leans forward and plays a gorgeous drive through the covers. Found the gap on the crowded off side infield to get a fence. SA are coasting along at the moment in this run chase.
Full and outside off, driven nicely but straight to short cover.
Fuller on off, blocked well off the front foot towards short cover.
Full and wide outside off, squeezed out towards the point region.

FOUR! BLUDGEONED! Short of a length outside off, flat-batted pull from Rossouw to the left of a diving mid off fielder as the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. Runs are bleeding here for the visitors.
MITCHELL MARSH comes on to bowl.
Back of a length outside off, de Kock stays back and punches it to cover.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the back foot to the off side.

FOUR! AND AGAIN! This is class batting! Back of a length outside off, stands tall and punches it on the up through the covers for another boundary. The Australian pacers struggling to find their radar at the moment.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! WOW! Short and wide outside off, cannot bowl there especially to southpaws. They'll eat you! Short and wide outside off, de Kock cuts it late through point to find the fence. He's on a roll here. Ominous signs for the Proteas.
Shortish on middle and off, de Kock rides the bounce and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Good length on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Shortish outside off, Rossouw cuts it towards backward point where a fumble allows the single.
Fuller and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

DE KOCK SURVIVES A SCARE! Length ball on off, goes for the whip across the line and gets a top edge on it. The ball goes way up in the air and straight over the keeper's head. Three Aussie fielders give chase and the ball just falls short of a diving Smith near the fence. Good stop and a single taken.
Good length on middle and off, de Kock gets across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle and off, worked towards mid on for a quick single.

FOUR! Lovely shot! Length ball outside off, not that short but it's the width that does it. Rossow stands tall and cuts it through point to find the fence. Fine timing on the stroke. Both the southpaws are dealing in boundaries.

FOUR! CLIPPED AWAY! Fuller and drifting on to the pads, de Kock shuffles across and flicks it neatly through square leg as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. SA off to a brisk yet steady start in this run chase.
Back of a length outside off, Rossouw gets back and rides the bounce to glide it down to third man for a single.
Shortish outside off, defended well off the back foot with the full face of the bat.

FOUR! NAILED IT! Dug in short on middle and leg, Rossouw gets back to that one and pulls it with power through mid-wicket as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. Positive blow from Rilee after some hiccups in the last two balls.
And again! Boland is making things happen! Back of a length on off, Rossouw closes the bat face too early and gets a leading edge. In the air but doesn't carry to Marsh at short cover.
The change almost works! Shortish on off, sticks off the deck as Rossouw mistimes the pull. Just short of a diving Head at mid-wicket.
SCOTT BOLAND comes on to bowl.
Back of a length outside off, de Kock flays it through point off the back foot. Head gives chase and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Length ball angled in from outside off, jammed from the crease towards point.
Amazing use of the wrists there from Quinton! Back of a length outside off, stays back and wrists it with a strong bottom hand through wide mid on for a couple.
Good length slanted in from around off, de Kock pushes at it and gets a leading edge to backward point.
Shortish and outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Good length angled in from outside off, punched off the back foot to cover.
Back of a length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Shortish and outside off, punched off the back foot to point where Head makes a good stop. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL SHOT! Good length outside off, a bit of width and Rossouw stands tall to punch it through extra cover on the up. Nobody moved as the ball raced away to the fence.
Back of a length on middle and off, worked off the back foot to mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and wide outside off, cut hard but straight towards point.

THAT WAS A CLOSE ONE! From around the wicket, length delivery angling in as de Kock swivels across to pull this away. It's in the air and it falls just short of the man at fine leg. Probably the lack of timing saved him there. A single is taken.
QDK stays back to this one and keeps it out. Solidly done.

FOUR! He's so elegant when playing his shots, isn't he? Fuller length delivery outside off, de Kock plants his front foot forward, leans into the shot and punches it ever so well to the right of mid off. Beats the man there with ease as the ball races away. Super shot.
Fullish in length and outside off, it's driven down to mid off for no run.
On a good length and angled across, Quinton gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad as he looks to punch it through the off side.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. It's on leg stump and de Kock just picks it up off his pads. Turns it through square leg and sends it all the way to the boundary line.
Back of a length around off, John comes over the wicket now for this, it's punched off the back foot to short extra cover.
Angling in on the pads, it's helped away down to long leg for one run.
Hastings comes from around the wicket now, has a change of angle for Quinton, bowls a length ball around off and gets it to straighten up. It's kept out well off the back foot.
FOUR! HE'S CARVED THAT! Back of a length delivery outside off, de Kock rocks back and cuts this through point to send it all the way to the fence for a boundary. Played that so well.

SIX! BEAUTIFUL PIECE OF TIMING! He's sent that all the way into the stands. Too straight from John Hastings and he bowls it around the pads, Quinton de Kock goes back and nails the pull perfectly over the deep backward square leg fence for a biggie.
Hastings bangs this one in short and it's pretty sharp and accurate. de Kock hops, gets on top of the bounce and just about manages to keep it down.
Wide! A sharpish back of a length ball which is going down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
JOHN HASTINGS will bowl from the other end.
Straying around the pads again, de Kock turns it in front of square leg for a single to end the over.
On middle and leg, this is pitched on a length and is quite straight, easily worked towards square leg for one.
Some nice swing there for Daniel Worrall. He pitches it right up there and gets it to go away from Rossouw. It goes off the outside edge and towards point.
He is off the mark. Straying on the hips here, Quinton de Kock just helps this down towards fine leg for an easy single.
Another length ball and it's on the stumps, de Kock once again stays inside his crease and works it softly to the on side.
Worrall starts off with a length delivery aiming the top of off stump, de Kock stays back and keeps it out with a solid straight bat.
We are back for the chase. It will be Quinton de Kock and Riley Rossouw to open for the hosts with Daniel Warroll taking the new ball first up. Let's roll...
